summary: Catherine entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Catherine
entries.definitive_edition: Catherine: Full Body, with Catherine Classic PC kept for original-version comparison

emulation.notes: Use native Full Body where possible; use PC Classic for original-route capture.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native Full Body on PS4/Switch for completeness; PC Classic for original-version capture

primary.why: Full Body is the expanded route for Catherine, adding a new heroine route, more story material, and updated presentation. Catherine Classic on PC is valuable for the original 2011 route and cleaner PC capture, but it does not include the Full Body additions.
primary.how_to_play: Use Catherine: Full Body on PS4 or Switch for the complete route. Record platform, patch, DLC state, difficulty, route/endings, Babel/Colosseum state, and whether Catherine Classic PC was compared for the original script and PC capture.

secondary.exclusive_content: Catherine Classic original-route preservation and PC capture
secondary.what_to_play: Use if documenting the original 2011 narrative balance or PC-specific presentation.
secondary.why: Full Body is more complete, but Classic is the original version identity.
Later routes are easier to capture or more complete.

all_releases.reason: secondary: historical baseline for the original version.

all_releases.fidelity: Original version on PC with modern capture/fix options.

all_releases.platform: PlayStation 4 / PlayStation Vita / Nintendo Switch Catherine: Full Body
all_releases.fidelity: Expanded version with added scenario material and updated presentation.
all_releases.reason: primary: most complete route for Catherine content.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Catherine Classic has the original PC route and easier capture; Full Body is more complete but is not on PC.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record route/endings and whether the run is Classic or Full Body; the story balance and route content differ.
